lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\ExeLearning\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

Nothing in the app calls 3 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 22 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
The frontend or a template builds 2 URLs below /apps/exelearning/ that no route of the app matches. The request fails at run time.

phpunit/phpunit is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
